field_verifications.proposed_value: CD3-positive T cells from lungs, lung-draining lymph nodes, bone marrow, and peripheral blood
field_verifications.evidence_text: We isolated mononuclear cells from donor lungs, lung-draining lymph nodes (LN) and bone marrow (BM) as previously described 10 , 11 . For BM and peripheral blood, we isolated mononuclear cells by density gradient centrifugation using Lymphocyte Separation Medium (Corning). T cells were enriched from all samples using magnetic negative selection for CD3 + T cells (MojoSort Human CD3 + T cell Isolation Kit; BioLegend), followed by a dead cell removal kit (Miltenyi Biotec), resulting in 80–90% purity. After stimulation, dead cells were removed as above before cell isolation for single-cell RNA-seq.
field_verifications.reason: These sentences link CD3+ T cells from lung, LN, BM, and peripheral blood to the single-cell RNA-seq assay.

field_verifications.proposed_value: single-cell transcript sequences and molecular counts for gene expression profiles
field_verifications.evidence_text: We barcoded captured mRNA was barcoded during cDNA synthesis and converted the barcoded cDNA into pooled single-cell RNA-seq libraries for Illumina sequencing using the Chromium Single Cell 3′ Solution (10x Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. All of the libraries were sequenced with an 8-base index read, a 26-base read 1 containing cell-identifying barcodes and unique molecular identifiers (UMIs), and a 98-base read 2 containing transcript sequences on an Illumina HiSeq 4000. After correcting for index swapping, we collapsed amplification duplicates using the UMIs and corrected errors in both the cell-identifying and UMI barcodes to generate a preliminary matrix of molecular counts for each cell
field_verifications.reason: The assay produced transcript sequence reads and per-cell molecular count matrices for gene expression analysis.
